settings.title: Settings
settings.claimExpiryHint: A claimed order is freed for others this long after its holder last worked on it.

sla.title: SLA per stage (minutes)
sla.hint: Flag orders that stay longer than this in a stage. Leave empty for no limit.

piiRetention.label: Keep customer details (days)
piiRetention.hint: Leave empty to keep them forever. Between 30 and 3650 days.

settings.qaMustDifferFromPacker: QA must be done by someone other than the packer

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.clearConfirm: Clear the {name}? The integration stops working until a new value is added.
integrations.writeOnly: Stored encrypted. Nobody can view it after saving, so keep your own copy if you need one.

queue.externalChange: Changed in the store after import

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this. Reload and try again.

box.nameTaken: A box with this name already exists.
box.inUse: This box is used by a package and can only be archived.

settings.encryptionKeyMissing: Secrets can't be saved: the server's encryption key is missing or invalid. Ask whoever runs the server to set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

workflow.takeOverConfirm: Confirm that you want to take this order over.
